name: Checkbox
summary: One on or off choice that is saved with a form, with an indeterminate state for a parent of mixed children.
useWhen: One yes or no choice that takes effect when the form is saved, such as agreeing to terms
Picking rows in a table or items in a list, where several can be picked
A parent that checks or clears a set of children, shown indeterminate when only some are checked
avoidWhen: A setting that takes effect the moment it changes
One choice among options that exclude each other
Several related choices under one question with one value array

size.description: Box of 12, 16 and 24 px in a target of 24 px, 24 px and the lg control height (40 to 48 px by density). Inside a CheckboxGroup it follows the group.

tone.description: The fill of a checked box. neutral is the text color, accent the primary fill of the style, danger for a destructive choice.

onCheckedChange.description: Called with true or false when the person toggles the box. Never called while read only.

label.description: Visible text after the box, a native label bound to the control. Without it, pass aria-label.

description.description: A hint under the label. Joins aria-describedby.

value.description: Sent with the form when checked. Inside a CheckboxGroup it is the value this box adds to the group array, and the group owns the checked state.

name.description: The form name. Inside a CheckboxGroup it follows the group.

id.description: The control id. Inside a Field it defaults to the Field control id.

invalid.description: Danger border on an empty box and aria-invalid. Inside a Field or a CheckboxGroup it follows them.

disabled.description: Native disabled on the control. Inside a Field or a CheckboxGroup it follows them.

readOnly.description: Keeps the value and focus, ignores clicks and Space, sets aria-readonly.

required.description: Sets aria-required. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

rootProps.description: Props for the root element. className and style also go to the root; the ref and every other prop go to the control.

a11y.role: checkbox, on the control (a Radix button). aria-checked is true, false or mixed.
a11y.focus: The control is the one tab stop. Focus shows the glow and a 2px ring around the box.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the control, and on to the next control
keys.Space: Toggles the box. Enter does nothing, as a native checkbox.

a11y.announce: Name from the label (or aria-label), the state as checked, not checked or mixed, the description through aria-describedby, and invalid and required.
notes: The box is 16px inside a 24px target. The label is a native label bound to the control, so it extends the target.
A checked box shows a check and an indeterminate box a minus, so the state never relies on color alone.
Read only is not part of Radix: clicks are prevented, aria-readonly is set and the box draws dashed.
Indeterminate is a display state. The next click checks the box.

en.label: A statement in sentence case that is true when checked: Email me a weekly summary. No question, no trailing period.
en.negative: Never a negative label such as Do not email me. A checked box turns something on.
en.terms: For agreement, say what is agreed: I agree to the terms of use.

ar.label: جملة قصيرة بصيغة الاسم، تصير صحيحة لما ينحدد المربع، بدون تشكيل
ar.negative: لا تستخدم النفي في العنوان، المربع المحدد يشغل الشي
ar.terms: في الموافقة، اذكر وش اللي ينوافق عليه بالضبط

styles.studio: Achromatic: the checked box fills with the text color and the glyph takes the body color. accent is a quiet overlay fill.
styles.desk: The same box. accent fills with the yellow primary and a dark glyph.

mistakes.wrong: A checkbox that saves a setting the moment it changes
Color alone shows that the box is checked
mistakes.right: The check and minus glyphs, which this component draws

mistakes.wrong: A disabled checkbox to show a value that cannot change
mistakes.right: readOnly, which stays readable and focusable

mistakes.wrong: A row of checkboxes with one label above them in a div
mistakes.right: A CheckboxGroup, a fieldset with a legend

mistakes.wrong: A Field label and a Checkbox label on the same box, which joins both into one name
mistakes.right: The Checkbox label only; use Field for its error and description

mistakes.wrong: A 16px box with no label and no wider target
mistakes.right: The control, which is a 24px target, and aria-label when there is no visible label
